smt.vmadot:
Vector Matrix Dot-product (signed × signed). Performs matrix multiply-accumulate on int4/int8/int16 inputs.

`C[i,j] += Σ(A[i,k] × B[k,j])`
smt.vmadotu:
Vector Matrix Dot-product (unsigned × unsigned). Performs matrix multiply-accumulate on uint4/uint8/uint16 inputs.

`C[i,j] += Σ(A[i,k] × B[k,j])`
smt.vmadotsu:
Vector Matrix Dot-product (signed × unsigned). Performs matrix multiply-accumulate with signed A and unsigned B.

`C[i,j] += Σ(A[i,k] × B[k,j])`
smt.vmadotus:
Vector Matrix Dot-product (unsigned × signed). Performs matrix multiply-accumulate with unsigned A and signed B.

`C[i,j] += Σ(A[i,k] × B[k,j])`
smt.vfmadot:
Vector Float Matrix Dot-product. Performs matrix multiply-accumulate on fp4/fp8/fp16/bfp16 inputs.

`C[i,j] += Σ(A[i,k] × B[k,j])`
